answer: Each submission hangs on the kernel of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the atlas is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
